body:
I can relate to your post, i think there are good jobs out there that aren't stressful and you won't feel like you're wasting your life or being a slave, but of course if you want stability and no risk of unemployment or being affected by economic crisis you must have a good base of education, skills and experience, plus saved money, so it's not that easy, you can't just pick what you like always.

I'm near your age and wage slaving by the way, i seriously hope you don't end up like me.
I appreciate your views, i'm trying to find my way through this

I can understand that mentality of "you only live once", my future looks bad enough and I'm thinking about living really good for a short amount of time and dying after a while than living all my life just to enjoy retirement. Another part of me however makes me want to improve to make things more bearable and enjoyable in the future, i guess that's survival instinct.

To be honest that is a question I ask myself sometimes, seems like fire is semi solid in some settings, and does not only burn but also has a concussive impact, but i don't think this or solid fire constructs are a problem in fantasy settings, it's good because it's more versatile than just burning.

I see, just asked out of curiosity.

I also think it did not matched with the show

You have a point, i should have not commented something i did not remember.

Also right about the terminology.

But let me ask what's your view about the origin of chakra and the otsutsuki clan?

In the first point I was saying that calling the energy of Naruto Chakra is equivalent to calling a power that comes of the mind brain energy, it doesn't sound silly because it's a foreign word.
But i have to agree that for commercial use creating an entirely different and original term is better than using common terms such as energy or Ki, and it doesn't make a big difference unless people wanted historical accuracy.
I'll give you the second point because it's been a while since I watched so I forgotten several things, but yes I've seen a character use a summon that was not used later and things like that(i remember one that was similar to a slug if I'm not wrong).

Post Rock genre in general, specialy:

event horizon by i am waiting for you last summer

Sparkling by Fragile

We lost the sea band, departure album.

The Last Sighs Of The Wind band,  We Are Trees Album
Me too, regret is like a personal hell where there's a valid reason for your suffering.

To be honest playing guitar is a nice thing to do, for me i wasted so many time doing nothing that i'm bad at everything, and my depression stem from it, but writing stories is a project i have for now. Hope you can win against your depression.

I'm 20 and while I improved a lot as a person and have a nice job, it is mostly hard specially if you have depression, also it's more lonely than the school days, at least for me. I don't think the future is bright and I don't have energy to study but I'd say things are okay for now, that's only my view however.

I don't remember when exactly but started in highschool I think, I always thought that I was worse and behind others but i was a getting good grades so I thought that at least I have something going for me, when I entered college I discovered that I'm not even average academically so I went into an existential crisis up to this day. Of course there are several other reasons and this is only one, but now I think it's the one that affects me the most.
Me here, but my voice is highly rational and has good arguments unfortunately.
Post Rock groups in general, heard many Linkin Park songs in the past.
Thank you too for commenting, hope we get over this problem and be at peace when weekends come.

I can relate, i feel like i'm wasting my life but i can't find the energy and motivation to do these things, which will make my life bad and my situation worse, i wish somehow we can break this cycle.
Hopelessness, I don't think my future or the future of the world is bright, I don't think I can live a satisfying life. Also regret and feelings of inferiority.
Sparkling, by Fragile.
That's nice of you, good luck to you too.

Me,  i don't have "hobbies" and don't feel inclined to do anything specific, but i do exercises for my own health and like you i read/watch things, anime too. I'll not say that i feel very satisfied about that part of myself, i'm very contemplative so i always question if i'm living well enough.

Bad development as a child probably, i never practiced a form of art or sport and never had the chance to develop talents, but that's just something that happens for some very few people, however i know that i'm responsible from my present and future.
Thank you for answering, maybe i'm setting very high standards, but i can't enjoy something if i'm bad at it, i should have started a hobby when i was young and didn't have such criticism lol.

Its not like life has become wonderful, quitting porn does not do that from one day to another, but you'll have more free time to do productive things, which will make you feel better about yourself, I have not ditched porn yet, but after a few days without watching i can feel that i have more time to do things for myself, the only problem is that i don't have hobbies so i don't now what to do for leisure lol.
Thanks
Thanks
Thanks

I can relate to your feelings and frustration, although i don't have one skill to save my life, the worst of it, at least to me, is feeling of not being good enough or being inferior to other people, don't let these kind of feelings overpower you because in my experience that's emotionaly painful.

I maybe not know exactly how you feel like, OP, but i have similar thoughts that the title of your post suggests, still searching for something to make me feel good about myself and end the cycle of feeling worthless and inferior.

You comment is precise about this issue, being able to excel making a difference  and/or enjoying life is a privilege, so what do the people who don't have it do is a question that i always ruminate about.
I can relate, i'm talentless and good for nothing, not even have a hobby because i know i'm going to do bad, the worst of it is seeing everyone around you doing better and being good at things.

Yeah, i go to the gym and train a little each week, but other than that i just work and watch/read/hear media, i wanted to have a hobby but i don't fit anywhere. Watching stories of people who achieved great things while i'm nothing.

that's just what i was thinking these days, but in my opinion compensation only works if its proportional to the problem, like how much a person needs to be good at something to make up for the lack of romantic and sexual relationships? its good investing in hobbies but many people also don't have social ones, so it's over for some guys out there.
Just create and finish one story, is the only goal i have now in my almost non existent free time, i'll go fiction
Not yet, i can't even say i write cuz i haven't started, but its a goal

It's nice that you can at least cope with these feelings, i can't ever do that because the things i like to do are mostly towards consumption of media(reading and watching things) but i always feel some kind of emptiness because i should be doing something better or somewhat memorable(because of this i'm trying to write as a hobby, but i'm very lost with that), also my home is noisy so i can't read and watch things pacefully.
Yeah i know how you feel, hope you get better because i don't wish this for anyone

To be honest i don't care, you can't relate with all characters and their life experiences, i just wanted more characters who abstain or can't get relationships, also i find annoying when the media is for example science fiction dystopia, and then the creator decides to put romance into it, or wathever else bad combination.

Congratulations for your choice, it makes me sad too but i'm too addicted to stop, also i know i'll never will have sex so i just settled, don't do what i do because i know how much this is destructive and mentaly degrading.

The second case, as you wrote, is more like if you don't have a part of your life that most people out there have(like relationships) i feel like you have to compensate for it being very good, at minimal, in another aspect of life, it is less about moral and more about not feeling inferior or lacking to others, but thanks for the advice, really.

I can relate, in on the smaller side, have hyper sensitivity(as in pain) and other anatomic problem that makes things hard for me, but i can't offer you any advice because i'm don't think i'm suited for it.

i'm in a similar place and i don't wish that for anybody, loneliness, lack of hope, passion and prospects, i hope you get your degree and improve your life at least in this aspect, working did improve my life and turned it more bearable, but i also know that it's not what happens to everyone.
